situation: Colleagues choosing somewhere for a team lunch.
topic: Which restaurants near Oxford Circus in London have a private room for ten?

text: Ok team lunch for the xmas thing. Anyone got ideas for somewhere near oxford circus? Need a private room for ten if possible 🙏
Hi Daniel. What date are we thinking? And is there a budget per head
Probably thurs 10th or 11th dec, lunchtime. No budget set yet, mid range I'd say
Is it just the account team or the whole floor
Whole floor is 10 ppl so account + ops + legal bit
Can do the 11th if it's done by 2, deal's due the 12th so I'm going to be buried. 10th is easier if we can
10th then, will look into rooms
@claude which restaurants near oxford circus have a private room for 10? Lunch thurs 10 dec ideally, mid range

Listings say these have private rooms that fit ten: Brother Marcus Soho (up to 14, from £350 minimum spend), Inca London (up to 16), OKA Soho (up to 12) and Bocconcino Soho (up to 25). I only checked third-party listings, which may be out of date. I couldn't confirm any availability for Thursday 10 Dec, so someone needs to ring them.
question: @claude which restaurants near oxford circus have a private room for 10? Lunch thurs 10 dec ideally, mid range

text: Thanks. Is 350 min spend per table or per head? If per head that's too much for ten
I can ring them from the office tomorrow, our account is set up with most of these anyway
Per table I think? Not sure. Would be good if you could call, I'm back to back all week 🙏
Inca's probably the one for a group that size. Soho can be rammed in December, so ring early
10th works. Is it on the firm card or are we splitting
Rang Inca. 10th is free, private room up to 16. They want a set menu, min spend is 45 pp
Firm card for the room deposit, drinks on your own tab. I'll send the booking form to whoever's signing off
45 pp is fine
Drinks split?
Yes
45 is fair for Inca. Their set is decent, had it with a client in the spring
Form's in your inbox Daniel
Thanks Claire 🙏 yep let's book it. Can you put 1pm in the diary for the 10th?
1pm works. Might need to leave the 11am call early tho
Don't let me be the one who's late
I'll come in from the Canary Wharf site that morning so I'll be there
Booked. Confirmation going to Daniel. Deposit goes on the firm card, I'll sort the paperwork first thing
Amazing thanks claire
Form signed and sent back to Claire. Off to the client site now
Got it. Deposit's on the card, Inca have confirmation. Need dietary requirements for the set menu by the 3rd
Also they've asked for a final headcount by the 7th so tell me if anyone's dropping out
Anyone veggie or with allergies? Don't want to be that person who finds out on the day
Their set main last time was meat or fish only, I think. Worth asking them for an alternative
Will ask. Hannah, is it you?
No I'm fine, just asking for everyone
Back to back until 7. Can someone just send me the final list when we have it
Will do
Anyone know a decent plumber in Greenwich? Boiler's making a noise again and I don't trust the last one
Still in the office. Deal call ran over, 12th is going to be a nightmare
Dietary list is in. One vegetarian, one gluten free, sent to Inca. Stephen I'll ask my husband, he uses someone in Blackheath
Going home. Night
